She helps Murdock by preparing the food for members of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. ==In animation== ===History=== ====Pre-series==== [[File:Murdock past.png|250px|left|thumb|Alcremie and [[Murdock]] in the past, alongside [[Mitchell (HZ019)|Mitchell]]]] As revealed during a flashback in ''[[HZ019|The Bittersweet Truth]]'', Murdock first caught {{p|Alcremie}} when she was a {{p|Milcery}}. She used to help Murdock and {{OBP|Mitchell|HZ019}} make cream for their cakes as they were a team of patisserie chef's, as she was their mascot for their shop. One day, she grabbed a [[Strawberry Sweet]] before spinning around with it, which triggered her [[Evolution]] into Alcremie, as she became Strawberry Ruby Swirl. Although she was able to help Murdock make Strawberry Ruby Swirl decorated cakes, Alcremie could't do the same for Mitchell's cakes, as he preferred matcha flavor. After Murdock and Mitchell get into an argument, Alcremie left with her Trainer when he decided to leave. Later, Alcremie joined Murdock when he became a member of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. ====''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''==== Alcremie first appeared in ''[[HZ004|The Treasure After the Storm!]]'', where she was getting fed by [[Liko]] on the [[Brave Olivine]]. In ''[[HZ008|The Door That Never Opens]]'', Alcremie was used to protect a cupboard that Murdock was keeping food in for his niece [[Dot]]. She attacked Liko and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} when they tried to have a look at what was in the cupboard. In ''[[HZ019|The Bittersweet Truth]]'', Alcremie and Murdock reunited with {{OBP|Mitchell|HZ019}} at the [[Battle Café]] in [[Motostoke]]. Alcremie was later used in a [[Double Battle]] alongside Liko and her Sprigatito against Mitchell and his {{p|Appletun}} and {{p|Slurpuff}}. However, their battle turned into a bake off. Despite this, Alcremie was happy that she got to work with Murdock and Mitchell as a team again. In the [[HZ033|third episode]] of [[Terapagos's Exploration Diary]], Alcremie joined Rockruff and {{an|Terapagos}} to eat in Murdock's kitchen, when more Pokémon joined the group, and things got out of control, {{TP|Dot|Quaxly}} tried to clean up the mess, but it was useless and [[Dot]] caught all the Pokémon having fun in the mess made in the kitchen. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Murdock and Alcremie.png|250px|thumb|Alcremie and Murdock]] Alcremie enjoys making sweets with [[Murdock]] and has a close relationship with him. As a Milcery, she enjoyed helping both Murdock and {{OBP|Mitchell|HZ019}} make cakes for them in their shop. However, after evolving into Strawberry Ruby Swirl Alcremie, she could only help with Murdock's cakes because Mitchell preferred matcha flavor and didn't go with his cakes. When Murdock had a fallout with Mitchell and ended his partnership with him, Alcremie felt responsible for their strained relationship, as seen in ''[[HZ019|The Bittersweet Truth]]'', when she got an angry stare from Mitchell after reuniting with him and when he and Murdock refused to speak to each other. Despite this, Alcremie still considers Mitchell a friend, as she got excited that she and Murdock were able to make cakes with him again, even though they were originally doing a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] against him. Alcremie also accepted Mitchell's request to put some of her cream on one of his matcha cakes. Alcremie is shown to be a kind Pokémon, as demonstrated in ''[[HZ021|The Lonely Hatenna]]'' when she offered {{TP|Liko|Hatenna}} some food. She usually helps Murdock and {{TP|Murdock|Rockruff}} guard the kitchen from anyone that would snoop in it, especially whenever her Trainer and teammate wasn't around, as seen in ''[[HZ008|The Door That Never Opens]]'', when she creamed [[Liko]] and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} for snooping in [[Dot]]'s cupboard. ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{fairy color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{fairy color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{fairy color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As a Milcery |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Murdock Milcery.png|250px]] |} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|fairy||Murdock Alcremie {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Acid Armor|1=Decorate}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Acid Armor|1=Decorate}}}} {{anmov|poison|Acid Armor|HZ019|The Bittersweet Truth}} {{anmov|fairy|Decorate|HZ019|The Bittersweet Truth}} {{anmov/f|fairy}} ===Gallery=== ====Artwork==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|5px}} border:2px solid #{{fairy color dark}}; background:#{{fairy color}}; font-size:80%" |- | style="{{roundy|5px}} border:2px solid #{{fairy color dark}}; background:#{{fairy color light}}" | [[File:HZ016-HZ019 AS.png|180px]] |style="{{roundy|5px}} border:2px solid #{{fairy color dark}}; background:#{{fairy color light}}; width:150px"| [[File:HZ New Years Eve 2023.jpg|x350px]] |- | colspan=1 |After the story
